extension.summary: Standalone Stremio-style catalog/stream client for Kodi with TMDb Helper integration, Plex/Emby/Silo sources, Trakt PIN linking and scrobble.
عميل مستقل لكتالوجات وروابط Stremio داخل Kodi مع دعم مشغّل TMDb Helper ومصادر Plex وEmby وSilo وربط Trakt عبر PIN.
extension.description: Standalone Dex Hub for Kodi. Add compatible Stremio manifests, browse provider catalogs, use native Plex, Emby/Jellyfin and Silo sources, play streams with external subtitles, link Trakt, reuse Dex Hub as a TMDb Helper player, and keep a unified local continue-watching list.

Dex Hub نسخة مستقلة لـ Kodi. أضف روابط Stremio، واستخدم مصادر Plex وEmby/Jellyfin وSilo الأصلية، وشغّل الترجمات الخارجية، واربط Trakt، واستخدم Dex Hub كمشغّل لـ TMDb Helper، وحافظ على قائمة متابعة موحّدة محلياً.

extension.news: 5.10.556: The new look: cards open up on Home, and small marks on the right show where you are among the rows. The title page: the picture sits on the right instead of behind the whole page, a new option 'Title page with tabs' (one section under the buttons, each loaded when you open it, so the page opens faster), and the page-look button opens a menu: layout, poster, tabs. Bar icon order: Settings > Home > Bar icon order moves any icon up or down in the side menu (also between the top and bottom groups), in the same order on the top bar. The Add-ons button is no longer doubled: it shows beside Search and Power only when the Add-ons section is hidden from the bar. Notifications are a glass card at the top right instead of a line at the bottom (with skin 3.28.224). 5.10.555: Plex no longer answers every search with the start of the library: the server-wide search sent the words in a form Plex ignores, so it returned 11 Rebels, 12 Monkeys and the rest, which filled the results and used the server's time before the real search was read (the box's log: HOMEMEDIA). It now searches by title, and rows sharing no word with the search are left out. The search and sources theme no longer changes with Left or Right in Settings (one Right turned Halo into Classic); it changes from its list with OK. 5.10.554: Dex Hub no longer hangs for good: when a call ended and the queued sources were cancelled, a wait with no limit kept it (and Kodi) waiting for ever (8 Nov log). The longest wait is now 3 minutes, and it stops when Kodi closes. Plex is no longer searched for a Silo id instead of the title, nor with an empty search that returned the start of the library and used up the server's time (why HOMEMEDIA kept hitting its 6 s limit with no results). An episode that arrives by its own IMDb id is looked up on the servers by the show's id and name. The two copies of the playback code are one again: fixes that lived in one only (the show id for episodes, the Plex time limit, auto-pick, logos, sizes) are in both. SMB sources are called SMB (and NFS ones NFS) instead of NAS, and full discs show their real picture: an ISO over 48 GB is 4K UHD BluRay, a BDMV folder is read from its index.bdmv, instead of 480p. The MDBList key sits beside the TMDb key in Settings / Metadata, and in Start in the Basic settings. An Add-ons button and a back-to-your-other-skin button on the top bar, the weather beside the clock and CPU temperature and RAM under it, each with a switch in Settings / Home (with skin 3.28.223). 5.10.553: IPTV lists come from the provider over your own connection when the provider turns DexWorld's server away (403): live channels keep loading, and the channels play as before. The title page in both layouts: the work's logo always shows and is bigger, a white Play button and glass buttons, colours from the artwork, the story in three still lines (with skin 3.28.222). 5.10.552: The side menu is glass and every name sits on its own icon's line; the section you are in is named at the top in a glass pill beside it (with skin 3.28.222). The rating card at the start of a film looks like Apple TV's: the rating large (TV over MA), a thin line, and each reason on its own line with its letter (L Language, V Violence, N Nudity, D Drugs, I Intense). New option Settings > Look > Posters with the logo: posters a little darker with the work's logo clear at the bottom. Also in this build, from 5.10.551: Add-ons is back on the bar (with skin 3.28.221) and in the Basic menu under System; Edit Home shows or hides it like the other sections. NAS files named unlike the title's page are found in its sources now: a folder called "F1 The Movie" shows for TMDB's "F1" (Dex Hub looks the NAS title up on TMDB and compares the ids). Also in this build, from 5.10.550: Your NAS and network folders (SMB, NFS) are in Servers now: each folder is a server with its Movies, Series and Recently added, posters from TMDB, and a title opens its page with the file among its sources. Folders already added in Kodi (the file manager, like Movies iso) are taken in by themselves, signed in as Kodi signs in. Edit Home > Add rows has a NAS choice to put a folder's films, series or newest files in any section. Also in this build, from 5.10.549: Kodi no longer crashes when a Red Light or POV source is played from a Home row or widget (Kodi's playlist was cleared while it still read it). Also in this build, from 5.10.548: The Full disc ISO filter no longer goes missing when AIOStreams has a bad moment: an answer that carries error rows for services that failed ([❌] Easynews+, Prowlarr) is no longer kept in the results cache, so the next search asks again instead of showing the short list (The Batman: 21 results instead of 159, its 3 full discs gone). Full Blu-ray ISO copies now play on LibreELEC as well (they failed with 'error probing input format'). Also in this build, from 5.10.547: No more frozen screen before playback with AIOStreams links that have no file extension (Dex Hub asked the link for its file type and waited, up to 27 s). It now takes the type from the file name or lets the player find it. The sources list opens faster: building and sorting the rows takes about half the time, and they are saved to the cache in one write instead of one per row. Search has its own workers instead of sharing them with the Home rows. A catalog that refuses searches (an error like 404) sits out for 30 minutes, one that never answers in time for 10 minutes, and it is back as soon as it answers. A repeated search uses the saved answers at once instead of waiting. Also in this build, from 5.10.546: The Full disc ISO filter and the ISO badge now show for AIOStreams results (their BR-DISK / ISO tag is in the description, which Dex Hub did not read). A disc link that takes long to start (usenet) is now waited for, up to 75 s, before Dex Hub decides it is not a disc. Also in this build, from 5.10.545: New settings page: Left and Right change a value right on its row, the line at the bottom says what the option does, and Back goes to the sections before closing. New Edit Home: only the rows you see are listed and the hidden ones fold into one line, Left and Right change a row's style, one Add rows button opens Dex Hub, DexWorld, YouTube or any add-on, and Back goes to the sections. The row menu had empty lines (Kodi's font has no emoji); fixed. Also in this build, from 5.10.544: No more error lines when TinyPPI, TMDb Helper or another add-on is installed but turned off (Dex Hub now treats it as missing). The English look no longer shows Arabic words in the Stremio sync menu, Silo menus and messages, folder covers and subtitle sync notes. The Show and hide rows button in Edit the Home screen had an empty label; fixed. Also in this build, from 5.10.543: Your NAS as a source (found on the network, guest folders open without a password). Full Blu-ray discs (ISO, BDMV) get a badge and a filter. Basic settings now have Sources and Rows sections; OK on a row opens one menu to hide, move or restyle it, and Show and hide rows ticks them all at once. Fixes Kodi 22 crashes that closed the app (Dex Hub and the Kodi add-ons it searches with no longer leave Python weak callbacks behind), and a second copy of the background service no longer starts. Kodi logs can be downloaded from the phone setup page. An IPTV get.php link added as M3U is added as Xtream (panels that refuse the playlist with error 884 still work). Continue Watching fills from Trakt again on a profile that had never pulled it.
